info.title: Elevant API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API for the Elevant platform.

post.summary: Exchanges valid Development credentials for a short-lived bearer token.

get.summary: Returns the current actor after revalidating its effective scope in SQL.

post.summary: Changes a verified password, then requires a fresh login.

put.summary: Creates or refreshes the current account's fail-closed device binding.

get.summary: Returns the planning snapshot for an authorized station and operation date.
Returns contract services and agent eligibility for one scoped turnaround.

ETag.description: Strong, opaque version of the current OCC planning representation.

post.summary: Assigns one eligible agent and materializes all applicable contracted services.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest OCC planning options response.

ETag.description: Strong, opaque version of the current OCC planning representation.

get.summary: Returns the bounded latest-submission queue for one authorized station.
Returns the latest submitted execution and its review evidence.
Lists immutable handoff revisions for one scoped operation, newest first.
Reads one immutable historical handoff, including its review decision.

post.summary: Approves or returns one pending submission using its strong snapshot token.

get.summary: Returns canonical incidents visible to the assigned ramp agent.

post.summary: Atomically reports one incident without duplicating offline retries.

get.summary: Returns the canonical checklist assigned to one accessible operation.

post.summary: Atomically submits every answer in one operation checklist.

get.summary: Returns only active operations assigned to the current ramp agent.

post.summary: Starts one operation assigned to the authenticated ramp agent.
Applies one audited, idempotent service status transition.
Atomically closes execution and records an idempotent submission.

get.summary: Confirms that the HTTP process is responding.

Bearer.description: Short-lived ELEVANT access token issued by POST /api/v1/auth/session.
